title: 第7章 慈心堂
slug: 似锦全本免费-似锦最新章节列表
content_zh:
卫氏冷笑：“等过了东平伯这一代，东平伯府的爵位就没了，到时候与平头百姓无异，他家女儿又自幼丧母，能嫁到咱们国公府来难道还要拿乔不成？”
安国公听了越发不满：“话不是这么说的——”
“老爷，难道你还看不出来嘛，三郎大了，有自己的主意了，不是靠棍棒管得住的。咱们要是不许他和巧娘在一块，他真有可能再做傻事。”卫氏说到这里抬手拭泪，“要是三郎有个三长两短，我也活不下去了——”
见安国公依然犹豫，卫氏嗔道：“老爷，不过是一个妾而已，有什么打紧的，内宅的事你就不要操心了，交给我去办吧。”
安国公叹了口气：“那好，明日一早你就去东平伯府走一遭，好好和人家说说。”
“老爷放心吧，这件事我会处理好的，咱们先进去看看三郎吧。”
夜里，季崇易发起了烧，急得卫氏一晚上没睡安稳，转日一早安国公世子夫人郭氏前来请安时便对她道：“昨晚上发生的事想来你也听说了，东平伯府那边你就代我走一遭吧。”
郭氏听了卫氏的交代，心下虽有几分为难却不敢推脱，忙去安排。
卫氏靠着弹墨引枕闭上了眼睛。
大郎媳妇是国公府的世子夫人，让她走这一遭已经给足了东平伯府脸面。只要抓紧把姜四姑娘娶过门来，这场风波便算过去了。
榆钱胡同口的早点摊子已经支了起来，摊子前围了不少人，新的一天便从喝上一碗加了木耳丝与嫩肉丝的豆腐脑开始了。
一声惨叫打破了东平伯府清晨的平静。
阿蛮匆匆进屋：“姑娘，老爷正在打二公子呢。”
姜似从梳妆台前站了起来，抬脚便往外走。
“姑娘，这不是去慈心堂的路——”阿巧提醒道。
慈心堂是东平伯老夫人的住处，按理说每日一早姑娘们应该先去各自母亲那里，再随着母亲一同前往慈心堂给老夫人请安，但姜似自幼丧母，一母同胞的长姐又早已出阁，于是每日就一个人过去了。
“先去二公子那里看看。”姜似加快了脚步。
阿巧越发纳闷，不由看了阿蛮一眼。
阿蛮同样一头雾水，轻轻摇头。
姑娘不到十岁的时候与二公子倒是顶好的，时常在一起玩，等年纪渐长就与二公子疏远了，特别是这两年见了二公子连话都没有几句。

今日姑娘有些反常。
据说人受了刺激就可能性情大变，昨夜姑娘受的刺激可不小。
两个丫鬟不约而同想到这一点，对安国公府三公子季崇易越发恼恨起来。
东平伯府共有四位公子，除了四公子年纪尚小依然住在后院，其他三位公子在前院全都安排了单独的院子，姜湛便住在听竹居中。
姜似才走到院门口，就听到中气十足的呵斥声传来：“小畜生，我说你最近怎么消停了，原来是偷着从狗洞爬出去胡作非为。你不是喜欢钻狗洞吗，今天老子就把你打得比大街上的野狗还惨！“
“野狗不惨啊。”一个弱弱的声音紧跟着传来，随后那声音变成惨叫，“父亲，您轻点啊，别打脸，别打脸——咦，四妹来了。”
追着姜湛打的男子背影高大，闻言一脚踹过去：“你四妹怎么会来？小畜生到现在还想糊弄我！”
姜似见状开了口：“父亲——”
那高大的背影一僵，缓缓转过身来。
东平伯姜安诚在见到小女儿的一瞬间神情柔和起来，甚至带了几分讨好：“似儿怎么来了？”
“听闻父亲在教育二哥，女儿来瞧瞧是怎么回事。”姜似回了姜安诚的话，看向姜湛。
十六七岁的少年已经到了长个子的时候，挺拔如一杆新竹，哪怕此时因为被追打显得有些狼狈，依然俊美逼人。
姜湛与姜似一样，相貌都随了母亲。
姜似对着姜湛略略屈膝，“二哥，你还好吧？”
姜湛蓦地瞪大了眼睛，对上姜似的视线耳根腾地红了，连连摆手道：“妹妹放心，我跑得快着呢。”
“小畜生，你跑得快是不是还挺骄傲的？”姜安诚好不容易才平息下来的怒火因为姜湛这句话又被点燃了。
姜湛下意识要跑，想到妹妹就在一旁看着可不能失了志气，硬生生忍住了，挺直腰板道：“父亲，您消消火。儿子皮糙肉厚，就算您打着不手疼，当心吓着妹妹。”

content_en:
Wei sneered: "After Uncle Dongping's generation, the title of Dongping's mansion will be gone. By then, he will be no different from ordinary people. His daughter also lost her mother when she was young. If she can marry into our Duke's mansion, will she still have to take Qiao?"
An Guogong became even more dissatisfied after hearing this: "That's not what you said -"
"Master, can't you see that Sanlang is old and has his own ideas, and he can't be controlled by sticks. If we don't allow him to be with Qiao Niang, he may do stupid things again." When Wei said this, she raised her hands to wipe her tears, "If Sanlang has his own shortcomings, I won't be able to live anymore -"
Seeing that An Guogong was still hesitant, Wei said angrily: "Master, I'm just a concubine. If it doesn't matter, don't worry about the affairs of the inner house. Leave it to me."
Duke An Guo sighed: "Well, early tomorrow morning you can go to Dongping Bo's Mansion and have a good talk with me."
"Don't worry, sir, I will take care of this matter. Let's go in and see Saburo first."
During the night, Ji Chongyi developed a fever, which kept Wei from sleeping all night. The next morning, when Mrs. Guo, the prince's wife, Duke An, came to pay her respects, she said to her: "I think you have heard about what happened last night. Please come to Dongping Uncle's Mansion for me."
After hearing Mrs. Wei's explanation, Mrs. Guo felt a little embarrassed, but she didn't dare to shirk it and hurriedly made arrangements.
Wei leaned against the elastic ink pillow and closed her eyes.
Dalang's daughter-in-law is the wife of the Crown Prince of the Duke's Palace. Letting her go has already given Dongping's Palace a lot of face. As long as Miss Jiang Si is married quickly, this storm will be over.
The breakfast stall at the entrance of Yuqian Hutong has been set up, and many people gathered in front of the stall. The new day starts with a bowl of tofu nao with shredded fungus and tender pork.
A scream broke the early morning calm of Dongping Bo Mansion.
Ah Man hurriedly entered the room: "Girl, the master is beating the second young master."
Jiang Si stood up from the dressing table, lifted his feet and walked out.
"Girl, this is not the way to Cixin Hall -" Ah Qiao reminded.
Cixin Hall is the residence of Mrs. Dongping Bo. It stands to reason that the girls should go to their mothers first every morning, and then go to Cixin Hall with their mothers to pay their respects to the old lady. However, Jiang Si lost his mother when he was young, and his eldest sister from the same mother has already left the court, so he goes there alone every day.
"Let's go see the second young master first." Jiang Si quickened his pace.
Ah Qiao became more and more puzzled and couldn't help but glance at Ah Man.
Ah Man was also confused and shook his head slightly.
When the girl was less than ten years old, she and the second young master were very good, and they often played together. As she grew older, she became estranged from the second young master, especially in the past two years, she had not even spoken to the second young master.
The girl is a little weird today.
It is said that people's moods can change dramatically when they are stimulated. The girl was greatly stimulated last night.
The two maids thought of this and became even more angry with Ji Chongyi, the third son of Duke Anguo.
There are four young masters in the Dongping Mansion. Except for the fourth young master who still lives in the backyard, the other three young masters all have separate courtyards in the front yard. Jiang Zhan lives in the middle of Tingzhu House.
When Jiang Sicai walked to the door of the courtyard, he heard an angry scolding: "Little beast, I asked you why you have stopped recently. It turns out that you secretly crawled out of the dog hole and caused mischief. Don't you like to get into dog holes? Today I will beat you worse than a wild dog on the street!"
"Wild dogs are not miserable." A weak voice came immediately, and then the voice turned into a scream, "Father, please be gentle, don't slap me in the face, don't slap me in the face - hey, the fourth sister is here."
The man who was chasing Jiang Zhan had a tall figure. Hearing this, he kicked him: "Why did your fourth sister come here? You little beast is still trying to fool me!"
Jiang Si saw this and spoke: "Father——"
The tall figure froze and slowly turned around.
Dongping Bo Jiang Ancheng's expression softened the moment he saw his little daughter.Even a little flattering: "Why are you here?"
"I heard that my father is educating his second brother. My daughter came to see what's going on." Jiang Si replied to Jiang Ancheng's words and looked at Jiang Zhan.
The sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy has reached the age of growth and is as tall as a new bamboo shoot. Even though he looks a little embarrassed because of being chased, he is still handsome and handsome.
Jiang Zhan, like Jiang Si, takes after his mother's appearance.
Jiang Si bowed slightly to Jiang Zhan, "Second brother, are you okay?"
Jiang Zhan's eyes widened suddenly, and his ears turned red when he met Jiang Xi's gaze. He waved his hands repeatedly and said, "Don't worry, sister, I'm running fast."
"Little beast, are you proud of how fast you run?" Jiang Ancheng's anger, which had finally calmed down, was ignited again by Jiang Zhan's words.
Jiang Zhan subconsciously wanted to run, but he couldn't lose his ambition when he thought that his sister was watching from the side. He held back, straightened his back and said, "Father, please calm down. My son has rough skin and thick flesh. Even if your hand doesn't hurt when you hit him, be careful not to scare my sister."
